rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A full-stack GitHub OAuth integration built with TypeScript that combines multiple interfaces into a single system. Provides secure authentication and token management through an Express.js REST API, a CLI tool for command-line workflows, and MCP server tools for AI agent integration. Features SQLite-based connection storage, type-safe SDK for programmatic access, and exposes GitHub operations like repository listing and issue creation through the Model Context Protocol.
